Vendored [uPlot](https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot) 1.6.32 (MIT, see `LICENSE`), so `bx view`
dashboards draw charts without network access.

The files are copied unmodified from the npm tarball `uplot-1.6.32.tgz`
(sha1 `c800a63b432bad692d6d746f44f0882aa73a49ae`): `dist/uPlot.iife.min.js`, `dist/uPlot.min.css`
and `LICENSE`. To upgrade, replace them from the new release's tarball and update the version here.
